assignment_control.boundary: no starred targets, arbitrary iterables, container-valued bindings, attribute/subscript writes, annotations or implicit unpacking exceptions.
assignment_control.evaluation: evaluate all scalar RHS leaves left-to-right once before any target write.

assumptions: scalar values and standard built-ins; no shared mutable aliases, monkey patching or implicit flows.
Explicit supported raises follow ordered builtin handlers and finally cleanup. Implicit exceptions, bound error objects, custom classes and resource effects remain unchecked.
finite origin sets; joins lose branch correlation; traces are derivations, not executable paths.

call_binding.binding: Bind positions, then exact keyword names; substitute in declaration order.
call_binding.boundary: No object-default reads, unchecked defaults/annotations, type parameters, used variadics, extra/unpacked args, async/generators, rule keywords or non-normalized names.
call_binding.defaults: Omitted defaults supply checked scalars; explicit args replace defaults. Other definition effects stay unchecked.
call_binding.definitions: Bodies defer; defaults capture literals, prior values/functions, builtins and selected float models. Local future annotations: <=128 nodes; no await/yield/assignment/type unpacking.
call_binding.evaluation: Evaluate explicit values once in source order before binding.
call_binding.initialization: Literals/collections, aliases, builtins, exports, instances and docs. Checked dictionary registration and loops <=128 syntax/expanded nodes; fresh ASCII writes, RHS first. Classes: unshadowed object/dict/Exception bases, slots and builtin method decorators.
call_binding.invalid: Missing, excess, duplicate or unknown arguments leave analysis incomplete; no TypeError model.
call_binding.parameters: ASCII positional-only, positional-or-keyword and keyword-only slots; checked defaults permit replacements.
call_binding.variadics: Omit unused ASCII variadics whose names never occur in the body. Calls bind fixed slots; annotations follow definition rules.

effect_limits.reason: A call through an object or computed function may read or change shared state; this analysis cannot determine its effects.

expression_control.boundary: scalar truth and comparisons; no overloaded protocols or implicit exceptions.
expression_control.comparisons: ordered operands; each comparison result may be true or false.
expression_control.effects: join normal, sink and explicit-raise alternatives.
expression_control.evaluation: left-to-right; each operand once per expression transfer.
expression_control.selectors: Boolean and None literals, not, parentheses and nested selected expressions.
expression_control.unknowns: retain both alternatives; no variable or call-result truth specialization.

modules.policy: Single-root modules/packages; local from-import names share a provider search. Child searches use the same budget. Explicit standard model bindings each use one lookup and require absent local candidates. Proved missing sibling imports may select literal metadata handlers. Unused plain module attribute hooks defer; required missing-member hooks stay unchecked. Cycles require available names in execution order. Supported future directives need absent local __future__ candidates. Imported non-entry modules may omit one exact main guard without other __name__ uses or alternatives. Dynamic imports, merged namespaces and search paths stay unchecked.

runtime_effects.complete_means: The scalar model finished; it does not check runtime exception safety or shared mutable objects.
